shortDescription: Thinking Machines Lab is in talks to raise at least $1 billion at a valuation of $40 billion before the investment, The Information reported on Thursday, citing a person familiar with the matter. Nvidia NASDAQ:NVDA is in talks to participate, the report added.

children: Thinking Machines Lab is in talks to raise at least $1 billion at a valuation of $40 billion before the investment, The Information reported on Thursday, citing a person familiar with the matter. Nvidia
is in talks to participate, the report added.
Existing investor Accel is in talks to lead the round.
The proposed valuation is below what Thinking Machines sought late last year, when it discussed raising $4 billion-$5 billion at a $50 billion-plus valuation, according to the report.

The startup in July released its first AI model, Inkling, which is open-weight — users can download, run and customize the underlying systems, unlike proprietary, closed-source models — serving primarily as an alternative to open-source offerings from Chinese AI labs.
Thinking Machines Lab is led by former OpenAI chief technology officer Mira Murati and is less than two years old.
